main_text.l: L. LEGATI EPISTOLA AD Episcopum Halberstadensem.

Paulus Marbasus popularis meus & eruditionis laude & testimonii vestri commendatione ornatus, ad me venit, cui licet omnia humanitatis officia propter ipsius virtutem, & communis patriæ necessitudinem exhibiturus fueram, eo tamen avidius præstabo, quod nullius Principis testimonio niti potuit, cujus ego voluntati, propter egregia in me merita lubentius obsequor. Quamvis igitur con-fecta

page.notes: The running head and heading are set in italic and small capitals; the catchword "fecta" is printed at the foot right, shown here as the word completing "confecta". Some letters in the italic lines are damaged and read with reasonable but not complete certainty, notably "Marbasus" and "Principis". The head "L." is a division numeral, given caput 50 as the printed Roman numeral L is not clearly confirmed.
